description: This file defines the ConceptDrugValidator class, which implements validation logic for Drug objects within the OpenMRS project. It includes methods to check if a given object is a Drug and to validate that its concept property is not empty.

classes.name: ConceptDrugValidator
classes.description: A validator class that ensures Drug objects have the required concept set; supports validation within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the class of the object being validated is assignable from Drug, indicating support for Drug validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a Drug object, specifically ensuring that the concept property is not empty, throwing an exception if the object is null or of an incorrect type.
